children: eGain's revenue fell 7% and earnings declined year over year, as SaaS revenue decreased 5% and professional services revenue fell 36%. Revenue from AI customers rose 7% and represented 66% of total revenue, while legacy customer revenue declined 25%; higher sales and marketing spending also weighed on operating income.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Revenue rose 7% to $14.4M and represented 66% of total revenue, compared with 57% a year earlier.
: Revenue declined 25%, including a 19% decrease in Cisco OEM and a 28% decrease from other legacy customers.
: SaaS revenue fell 5% and professional services revenue decreased 36%.
: SaaS costs rose 11%; gross margin was 73%, compared with 75% a year earlier.
: eGain expects fiscal 2027 revenue to decline as legacy customer revenue falls more than AI customer revenue grows.
